cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)

project(sshhelper_terminal C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The Android ABI-specific static library is generated by
# scripts/build-libghostty-android.sh into app/build/ghostty/<ABI>.
set(GHOSTTY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../build/ghostty")
set(GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB "${GHOSTTY_ROOT}/${ANDROID_ABI}/libghostty-vt.a")

if(NOT EXISTS "${GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "libghostty-vt static library not found: ${GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB}\n"
        "Run scripts/build-libghostty-android.sh first.")
endif()

add_library(sshhelper_terminal SHARED
    ghostty_terminal_jni.cpp
)

target_include_directories(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE
    "${GHOSTTY_ROOT}/include"
)

# libghostty-vt is built as a static archive. Linking it into our own shared
# library avoids shipping the upstream SONAME and keeps ABI control local.
target_link_libraries(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE
    "${GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB}"
    log
)

target_compile_definitions(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE GHOSTTY_STATIC)

# The ABI-specific OpenSSL/libssh2 static libraries are generated by
# scripts/build-libssh2-android.sh into app/build/ssh-native/prefix/<ABI>.
set(SSH_NATIVE_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../build/ssh-native/prefix")
set(LIBSSH2_STATIC_LIB "${SSH_NATIVE_PREFIX}/${ANDROID_ABI}/lib/libssh2.a")
set(LIBCRYPTO_STATIC_LIB "${SSH_NATIVE_PREFIX}/${ANDROID_ABI}/lib/libcrypto.a")

if(NOT EXISTS "${LIBSSH2_STATIC_LIB}" OR NOT EXISTS "${LIBCRYPTO_STATIC_LIB}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "libssh2/libcrypto static libraries not found under ${SSH_NATIVE_PREFIX}/${ANDROID_ABI}\n"
        "Run scripts/build-libssh2-android.sh first.")
endif()

add_library(sshhelper_ssh SHARED
    ssh/ssh_algorithm_policy.cpp
    ssh/ssh_blocking_connection.cpp
    ssh/ssh_connect_operation.cpp
    ssh/ssh_direct_operation.cpp
    ssh/ssh_error.cpp
    ssh/ssh_hostkey.cpp
    ssh/ssh_http_proxy.cpp
    ssh/ssh_jni.cpp
    ssh/ssh_libssh2.cpp
    ssh/ssh_libssh2_nonblocking.cpp
    ssh/ssh_operations.cpp
    ssh/ssh_proxy_operation.cpp
    ssh/ssh_runtime.cpp
    ssh/ssh_socks5_operation.cpp
    ssh/ssh_socks5_proxy.cpp
    ssh/ssh_socket.cpp
    ssh/ssh_transport.cpp
)

target_include_directories(sshhelper_ssh PRIVATE
    "${SSH_NATIVE_PREFIX}/${ANDROID_ABI}/include"
)

# Both libraries are static and merged into libsshhelper_ssh.so; no separate
# libssh2.so/libcrypto.so/libssl.so is ever packaged.
target_link_libraries(sshhelper_ssh PRIVATE
    "${LIBSSH2_STATIC_LIB}"
    "${LIBCRYPTO_STATIC_LIB}"
    log
)

# Keep Android 15+ 16 KB page alignment deterministic even if the default
# NDK/linker settings change in a future AGP release.
target_link_options(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE
    "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384"
)
target_link_options(sshhelper_ssh PRIVATE
    "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384"
)
